title: Programs for summoning UFOs, such as Skywatchers, and special access programs

tellings.quote: you have these summoning programs of UFOs like Skywatchers this kind of modern version of this or whatever, but it seems like we've been doing this kind of in, you know, special access programs for a while.

plain: There are said to be efforts to call UFOs to appear on purpose, such as Skywatchers, which Michels describes as a modern version of this, and he suggests the US government has been doing the same thing for a while inside special access programs, its most restricted secret projects. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about secret societies and the UFO cover-up. If true, it would mean contact has been sought deliberately, not just waited for.
